title: Mirror verifier views
hypothesis: A shared branch verifier plus one Mirror phase coordinate per candidate can recover correlated accept/reject functions with lower actual payload than independent MTP-style verifiers while preserving exact valid-path accuracy and improving on hard tying.
mirror_coordinate: One learned Givens view angle per candidate branch

development.selection_metric: branch NLL and exact four-branch valid-path accuracy after 500 Adam updates at LR 0.02

success_gate: On aligned fresh worlds, Mirror NLL <=1.10x independent MTP and no worse than MTP valid-path accuracy by >0.01; payload <=0.80x MTP; report branches/s and compare the rank-2 shared control. This is a synthetic branch-verification mechanism gate only.
failure_gate: Both development worlds miss quality or actual-byte gates, or the simple rank-2 shared control matches Mirror quality at lower payload and compute. Keep fresh sealed after failure.
boundaries: Teacher is generated by four Givens views
Sequential baseline scores branches one by one but has no Transformer KV cache
No speculative acceptance or end-to-end decoding claim
